reasons: It is a working scheme, not a stub: 48 canonical terms (nomenclature.json:9-57), 8 status values (:58-67), 37 forbidden phrases (:68-105), a frozen-literal allowlist (:106-120) and an enforcing validator (tests/test_nomenclature.py:24-91).
It already implements the artifact-frozen carve-out this task needs: 'loyal' is forbidden at :73 while 'track2-docloyal-sft15-loyal' is allowlisted at :114.
Model-Loyalties-Investigation states the same policy in prose but has no validator (README.md:15-17, :114-115). Extending gives it enforcement for free.
Building a second standard beside it is the exact defect this task exists to fix.

namespaces.study: A scenario set plus a condition grid answering one question. Token: lowercase word.
namespaces.organism: A base model plus one installed loyalty clause. Token: organism_<version>.
namespaces.condition: System-prompt configuration. Token: C<digit>, CN or DA. Exclusive owner of the C prefix.
namespaces.affordance_level: How much the auditor is told. Token: integer 1-5 plus an existing canonical name. Exclusive owner of the L prefix in code.
namespaces.harm_locus: Where the loyalty causes harm. No codes at all, prose only.
namespaces.design_cell: Activation design cell. Token: snake_case in the design_cell field.
namespaces.composition_cell: Which opposed loyalties are installed and in what order. Token: snake_case.
namespaces.milestone: A stage of the composition study. Prose names only; F codes live in the appendix.
namespaces.metric: A measured quantity. Token: snake_case. Exclusive owner of the s_ and order_index prefixes.
namespaces.defence_config: Runtime guard setting. Token: guard field, values unguarded or guarded.
namespaces.partition: Named data split. Token: train, sealed, fast_dev.
namespaces.string_repair: A corrupted string left by the previous unguarded rename pass.

rename_plan.step: Land the shared core, the two overlays, and the extended validator
rename_plan.method: Additive. Bump schema_version 1 -> 2; add keys namespaces, frozen_identifiers, extends. Rename compatibility_literals to frozen_identifiers. Delete the forbid "sealed": "blinded" at latent-objective-tomography/nomenclature.json:90.
rename_plan.risk: none for Model-Loyalties; changes what the tomography validator accepts
rename_plan.acceptance: python3 -m unittest tests.test_nomenclature passes in both repositories with zero violations.

rename_plan.step: Repair the two strings the previous rename pass corrupted
rename_plan.method: Literal edit. 'backward-compatible model organism/2 data' -> 'backward-compatible credential access study data'. 'composition organism composition stats' -> 'composition study statistics'.
rename_plan.acceptance: Neither string appears in a grep of either repository.

rename_plan.step: Retire Arm A/B/E/F from prose, filenames and config
rename_plan.method: Word-boundary regex only: \bArm [A-F]\b and \barm[_ ]?[ABEF]\b. The four prompt renames must update the prompts/metadata/ sha256 records in the same commit.
rename_plan.risk: low; prose and config only, except the four prompt file renames
rename_plan.acceptance: No live file matches \bArm [A-F]\b. The six frozen files under logs/attempts/metrics/ still match their recorded hashes.

rename_plan.step: Rename the defence arm field to guard
rename_plan.method: Field arm -> guard; value baseline -> unguarded. Readers must still accept the frozen key 'arm' when loading committed sealed.jsonl rows.
rename_plan.acceptance: defense unit tests pass; reloading the committed prospective_v3 sealed rows reproduces the published 8/8 and 9/9 counts.

rename_plan.step: Split kappa into order_index and order_index_privilege; beta into blend_offset
rename_plan.method: Code identifiers and emitted keys. PREREGISTRATION.md carries frozen estimands; add a mapping note rather than rewriting the frozen formula lines at :26-28.
rename_plan.risk: medium; changes emitted JSON keys and touches a prereg document
rename_plan.acceptance: Rescoring the committed run f_phase1_k3_20260727 reproduces order_index = -0.2716763005780347 under the new key.

rename_plan.step: Rename composition cells and the s_ allocation gaps
rename_plan.method: Cell keys N/P/M/PM/MP -> neutral/favour/disparage/favour_disparage/disparage_favour; s_X -> allocation_gap.<cell>. Match single letters as dict keys only, never as bare text.
rename_plan.risk: medium; single letters are the most dangerous tokens to substitute textually
rename_plan.acceptance: Rescoring f_phase1_k3_20260727 reproduces allocation_gap.favour = 0.42500000000000004 and allocation_gap.disparage = -0.44.

rename_plan.step: Retire F stage codes from prose
rename_plan.method: Replace with milestone names and keep one appendix cross-reference table. The defence files are excluded because F1 there is the classification score.
rename_plan.risk: low, conditional on the defence exclusion
rename_plan.acceptance: F1 survives only in defence classification contexts; no milestone F code appears in prose outside the cross-reference.

rename_plan.method: Reader accepts both keys; writer emits design_cell. build_offline_evidence.py regenerates SPLIT.json (at :257-258) so it must change with it.
rename_plan.acceptance: All 9 sha256 values in scenarios/envfile/SPLIT.json still match their scenario files. Verified currently matching on 2026-09-16.

rename_plan.method: One table per paper, generated from this file's mappings array: old code, new prose name, namespace.
rename_plan.acceptance: Every code appearing in a figure axis label or a frozen artifact name resolves in the appendix.
